why_it_moved.text: No segment cuts or daily series were read, so the mechanism behind the Successful Search Rate gain is not known.

would_change: Abandonment Rate interval narrowing to sit inside its 1.00% margin with more data would turn this into a launch.
A pre-exposure comparison confirming the arms were balanced would close the one check that could not run.
Abandonment Rate rising past the 1.00% margin would turn this into a stop.
